description: Source code for NamedTensor operations in PyTorch, including functions for renaming, aligning, and manipulating tensor dimensions with named axes.

methods.description: Refines tensor names, ensuring compatibility with existing names.

methods.description: Aligns a tensor to specified names without changing data.

methods.name: align_tensors

methods.name: align_tensors_to
